rustic_wedding_box.name: Rustic Wedding Keepsake Box
rustic_wedding_box.refined_prompt: A beautifully crafted wooden keepsake box for weddings, rustic farmhouse style, made from light to medium oak wood with visible natural grain patterns. The box measures 10x7x3.5 inches with a hinged lid that fits snugly. Features an antique brass latch mechanism with a small padlock (includes 2 keys). The lid is laser-engraved with elegant script font 'Our Forever Starts Here' centered on the top, with space below for wedding date in 'EST. [Date]' format. Optional space for couple names. Interior lined with soft cream-colored velvet fabric. Natural wood grain visible throughout. Clean product photography, white or light neutral background, professional Etsy listing style, warm wood tones, romantic and timeless aesthetic. Box has clean lines, professional finish, ready for personalization. No text labels, just elegant engraving.
strengths: Good balance of rustic and elegant

modern_minimalist_box.name: Modern Minimalist Keepsake Box
modern_minimalist_box.refined_prompt: A sleek modern wooden keepsake box, minimalist Scandinavian design, made from smooth dark walnut wood with subtle wood grain. The box measures 10x7x3.5 inches with a hinged lid and clean lines. Features a simple magnetic closure (no visible hardware). The lid is laser-engraved with a geometric pattern consisting of interconnected circles and lines forming triangles and quadrilaterals. The pattern has a central rectangular space left blank for personalization (names and date). Interior lined with dark gray felt fabric. Clean studio lighting, minimalist product photography, neutral gray or white background, sharp focus, contemporary design, sophisticated and elegant aesthetic. No labels, text, or branding - just clean geometric design with personalization space. Professional finish, ready for customization.

baby_memory_box.name: Baby Memory Box
baby_memory_box.refined_prompt: An adorable wooden keepsake box for babies, playful nursery style, made from light maple or birch wood with rounded corners for safety. The box measures 10x7x3.5 inches with a hinged lid. Features a small heart-shaped metal clasp in gold or brass color, centered on the front edge. The lid is laser-engraved with 'Baby's First Year' in playful script font at the top, with space below for baby's name and birth date. Optional cute animal silhouettes (bunny, bear, elephant) arranged around the text. Interior lined with soft velvet fabric in pastel colors (blue, pink, or neutral). Clean product photography, soft pastel background, family-friendly aesthetic, warm and inviting. Box has rounded edges throughout for safety, professional finish, perfect for new parents.

interior.note: Simplified from quilted to velvet for easier manufacturing

vintage_memorial_box.name: Vintage Memorial Keepsake Box
vintage_memorial_box.refined_prompt: A heartfelt wooden memorial display box, vintage heirloom style, made from rich cherry or mahogany wood with smooth finish. The box measures 10x7x3.5 inches with a hinged lid. Features an antique brass clasp on the front. The lid is laser-engraved or CNC-carved with 'In Loving Memory' in classic serif font, surrounded by simplified floral motifs and oak leaf patterns (optimized for CNC production, not hand-carved). Interior lined with burgundy velvet fabric. Warm, respectful lighting, emotional product photography, soft neutral background, dignified and respectful aesthetic. Traditional craftsmanship feel but optimized for efficient production. Professional finish, ready for personalization.
personalization_options: Pet memorial option (with paw print motifs)
